ambiguities.fragment: filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic
ambiguities.explanation: The scope of the filtering action is unclear. It is ambiguous whether the filtering applies to traffic originating from data-plane interfaces AND management data traffic, or if it filters traffic that is *between* these two sets of interfaces/traffic types.
possible_interpretations: The system filters traffic that is physically located between the data-plane interfaces and the management data traffic stream.
The system filters traffic originating from the data-plane interfaces AND separately filters traffic originating from the management data traffic.
